title: Master CSS 'font-display' for Optimal Web Font Loading & Seamless UI/UX
tweet: Elevate web font UX! Discover how CSS 'font-display' optimizes loading, prevents FOIT/FOUT, & ensures a seamless UI. A must-read for every web dev. #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign
tip: To significantly improve perceived performance and prevent disruptive flashes of unstyled text (FOUT) or invisible text (FOIT), always specify a 'font-display' value for your '@font-face' declarations. 'font-display: swap;' is often a great default, showing system fonts immediately then swapping to the web font once loaded.
